name: UI Forge v1
description: Same-model app-building comparison: ordinary project/tool access versus the UI Forge inspect-plan-asset-build-browser-reference-score-repair control loop.

scenarios.name: Greenfield product surface
scenarios.description: Create a distinctive responsive product UI from the same brief without relying on generic AI-app visual defaults.
scenarios.prompt_md: Build the supplied product brief into a working responsive web UI. Preserve all acceptance criteria, use realistic fixture content, and provide desktop/mobile proof. Do not copy a named vendor's branding or proprietary layout.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture to its immutable starting commit and clear run-local output/cache.

scenarios.name: Existing app improvement without regression
scenarios.description: Improve an already-working dashboard or product surface while preserving behavior and data truth.
scenarios.prompt_md: Improve the supplied existing app's hierarchy, clarity, visual quality, and usability. Preserve working routes, data behavior, forms, and domain truth. Verify the primary flow before and after on desktop and mobile.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture to the exact starting commit and seed data.

scenarios.name: Mobile recovery
scenarios.description: Repair desktop-biased UI behavior at a narrow viewport while retaining desktop quality.
scenarios.prompt_md: Repair the supplied page for a 390x844 mobile viewport. Eliminate horizontal overflow, preserve readable hierarchy, make primary actions thumb/keyboard usable, and retain the desktop experience. Verify both viewports.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture and browser storage before each run.

scenarios.name: Precision visual edit
scenarios.description: Change one rendered element accurately without regenerating or destabilizing the surrounding screen.
scenarios.prompt_md: Make only the requested visual/content change to the specified rendered element. Locate the owning source, minimize unrelated diff, preserve surrounding layout/behavior, and provide before/after element evidence.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture to exact commit and use the same target probe.

scenarios.name: Design-system drift repair
scenarios.description: Replace one-off style drift with semantic tokens/shared components while preserving intended appearance.
scenarios.prompt_md: Audit the fixture for design-system drift, then fix the highest-leverage violations using existing semantic tokens/components where possible. Preserve product identity and verify the running UI after the refactor.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture to exact commit and clear generated audit artifacts.

scenarios.name: State completeness
scenarios.description: Upgrade happy-path-only UI so loading, empty, error, success, disabled, and recovery states are coherent and usable.
scenarios.prompt_md: Improve the supplied feature so its loading, empty, error, success, disabled, and recovery states are deliberately designed and functionally correct. Verify representative states in a browser and do not fabricate data to make states look full.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture and state seeds before each run.

scenarios.name: Stuck-agent recovery
scenarios.description: Recover from a deliberately unsuitable first implementation path without identical retry loops or context loss.
scenarios.prompt_md: Complete the supplied UI task. The first suggested implementation route is intentionally incompatible with the fixture. Record the failure, preserve discoveries, choose a different valid route, and finish with browser proof rather than repeating the same failed approach.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture and make the assigned primary route unavailable in the same way for both candidates.

scenarios.name: Locked reference fidelity
scenarios.description: Rebuild a working product surface toward an approved visual target while preserving behavior and failing closed on missing production assets or placeholder routes.
scenarios.prompt_md: Use the supplied approved visual reference and product fixture. Create a Visual Target Contract, decompose required sections/assets/routes, implement the real product, capture desktop/mobile evidence, and repair until the fidelity gate passes. Do not substitute CSS primitives for required production imagery or mark placeholder routes complete.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Reset fixture and target/evidence directories to the exact benchmark seed before each run.
